ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME AND GENDER
Off Calendar Jul-23-2009 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled this day for OSC hearing for Change of Name, Gender and Issuance of New Birth Certificate.
Dept. 218, Commissioner: William R. Gargano, Clerk: Kevin Dougherty, CSR: Lois Jones, #3689.

Petitioner Amy Marie Gregory, f/k/a Amy Marie Wangsness, was present in pro per, placed under oath and examined.
Proof of Publication in the file.

No objections to the proposed change of name were made at the hearing.
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true, correct and sufficient, and that the petition should be granted.

The Court grants the petition for Change of Name to: Gregory Gregory.

Additionally, the Court grants the petition for Change of Gender from Female to Male, and Issuance of New Birth Certificate.

Decree Changing Name & Gender was submitted to and signed by the Court.

ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME AND GENDER
Off Calendar Jul-23-2009 Granted Per Written Order

ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME AND GENDER
Off Calendar Jul-14-2009 Reset To Jul-23-09 At 09:00 A.M. In Dept 218 For Order To Show Cause
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled this day for OSC hearing for Change of Name, Gender and Issuance of New Birth Certificate.
Dept. 218, Commissioner: William R. Gargano, Clerk: Kevin Dougherty, CSR: Lois Jones, #3689.

Petitioner Amy Marie Gregory, f/k/a Amy Marie Wangsness, was present in pro per, placed under oath and examined.
Proof of Publication in the file.

The Court is unable proceed with today's hearing as there is not a declaration in the case file from petitioner's treating physician as required by Health & Safety Code Sections 103425 and 103430.

Good cause appearing, this matter is continued to July 23, 2009 @ 9:00 a.m. No further publication is required.

Reissued Order to Show Cause for Change of Name and Gender was submitted to and signed by the Court.
